verdict.line: You lose if you let Gwen poke you down with Q and E resets before level 6; you win if you force the all-in once her E and W are both down.

brief.thesis: Gwen has no hard CC and her entire kit is tempo-based — Q (Snip Snip!) charges, E (Skip 'n Slash) dash-resets, W (Hallowed Mist) untargetability — so the matchup is decided by whether you let her dictate when the mist goes up or whether you force trades on her cooldowns. Fiora's 52.9% win rate over 869 games and the solo-kill edge both come from the same read: once E and W are down, Gwen has nothing but autos and a 6.5-3.5s Q cooldown standing between her and a dead lane.

theirWindow.what: She's gained attack speed, extra range, and magic damage on-hit for a few seconds, and landing an auto in that window partially refunds the dash. Back off or pop W (Riposte) to parry the follow-up auto instead of trading into it.

yourWindow.when: Gwen's E and W (Hallowed Mist) are both on cooldown
yourWindow.what: She has no dash to disengage and no mist to hide in. Double-Lunge with Q, hold W (Riposte) for her auto, and commit the full all-in — Duelist passive stacking off every hit keeps you topped up through her Q true-damage ticks.

start.why: Run by 94.8% of Fiora players into this matchup (53.1% WR, 974 games) — the extra sustain and AD let you answer her Q poke without losing the trade war.

boots.why: Gwen's entire damage profile is magic (Q true-damage center aside, her passive and E on-hit are magic) — the 53.2% win-rate boots buy you the MR to shrug off her poke.

core.why: Highest win-rate path (57.1%, 170 games) — the sustain from the active lets you out-trade her passive's health-based magic damage.
Spellblade burst turns your Lunge double-strike into a real all-in tool once her E is down.
Completes the top win-rate path and banks damage so her on-hit poke doesn't burst you before your Duelist passive heals it back.

situational.when: she's building full magic pen or you're getting bursted in extended trades
you're ahead and want to shield through her E auto-reset window
you want more sustain than Hydra against her poke-heavy lane

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards consecutive hits exactly like your Lunge-into-auto trade pattern, and the burst punishes Gwen for standing still after an E dash.

summoners.why: Run in 92.3% of games at 53% WR — Ignite backs up the solo-kill advantage this data shows, since Gwen has no hard peel once her E and W are on cooldown.

playing.title: Track her E cooldown, not just W
playing.detail: Skip 'n Slash (13-11s CD) is her only gap-close and escape. If it's down, she can't disengage your Lunge chain — that's your all-in signal more than her mist.

playing.title: Don't chase into Hallowed Mist
playing.detail: W makes her untargetable by anyone outside the mist, but you become targetable the moment you step in. Only walk in if you're committing to the kill, not to poke.

playing.title: Hold Riposte for her auto, not her Q
playing.detail: Riposte only parries basic attacks — it does nothing against Snip Snip!'s cone. Save it for the auto she throws out after an E dash or during a stand-off.

playing.title: Double-Lunge to close the gap
playing.detail: Q can be reactivated within a couple seconds at no mana cost. Use the first dash to close distance and the second to extend the trade before she can E away.

playing.title: Respect her Q charge count pre-6
playing.detail: Snip Snip! fires up to 6 times at 6.5-3.5s cooldown and the center bolt is true damage. Don't facetank the center of the cone during a full combo.

playing.title: Save Blade Waltz for isolated picks
playing.detail: R hits every nearby champion with diminishing returns per target, but against a single Gwen with no CC to stop it, landing it at level 6 is close to a guaranteed kill if her Flash is down.

playing.title: Trade through her passive, don't out-poke it
playing.detail: A Thousand Cuts scales off your current health and heals her — don't sit in extended auto trades at range. Burst in, land your combo, and leave before her on-hit ticks add up.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate numbers are measured from current-patch OP.GG data; the cooldown reads and trade-pattern advice are my own tactical judgement layered on top.
